safe-load-indicator-eot-crane.name: Safety For EOT Crane
safe-load-indicator-eot-crane.tagline: Advanced safety and automation system for overload prevention and accident control.
safe-load-indicator-eot-crane.overview: The Safe Load Indicator (SLI) is an advanced safety and automation system designed for EOT Cranes to prevent overload, instability, and unsafe lifting conditions. The system continuously monitors critical parameters and provides real-time visual and audible alerts, ensuring operator safety, crane protection, and compliance with safety standards.
keyFeatures: Single Unified Display: Real-time load data for main and auxiliary hooks.
Multi-Load Monitoring: Independent readouts for multi-hook configurations.
Wi-Fi Access Point: Wireless calibration without software installation.
Mobile Friendly: Responsive web interface for adjustments via phone/tablet.

calibrationSetup.title: Seamless Setup & Smart Control
calibrationSetup.description: The SLI system features a built-in Wi-Fi Access Point, enabling wireless calibration and configuration. All adjustments are performed via a secure, mobile-friendly web page.
steps: Multi-Load Calibration: Supports up to 8 independent load points for precision.
Tilt Angle Setup: 'Angle Reset' button instantly sets current angle as 0°.
Safety Configuration: Input boxes for Load, Tilt, Wind, and Rope slack limits.
Toggling Options: Interface buttons to enable/disable safety parameters.

safetyParameters.title: Overload Protection (OVLD)
safetyParameters.description: Automatic hoist cutoff during overload. Displays 'OVLD' and triggers buzzer.

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Tilt Protection (ATP)
safetyParameters.description: Triggers at ±5°. Displays 'ATP' and prevents instability.

safetyParameters.title: Rope Slack Protection
safetyParameters.description: Detects slack to prevent load drops and mechanical stress.

safetyParameters.title: Error Indication System
safetyParameters.description: ERR 1 (Comm issue) Quick fault identification.

safe-load-indicator-gantry-crane.name: Gantry Crane Safety
safe-load-indicator-gantry-crane.tagline: Heavy-duty stability and wind speed monitoring for industrial gantry systems.
safe-load-indicator-gantry-crane.overview: The Safe Load Indicator (SLI) is an advanced safety and automation system designed for Gantry Cranes to prevent overload, instability, and unsafe lifting conditions. It includes an Anemometer for wind speed monitoring, essential for outdoor gantry operations. The system ensures compliance and maximum operator safety.
keyFeatures: Anemometer Integration: Real-time wind velocity measurement and auto-cutoff.
Single Unified Display: Real-time load data for main and auxiliary hooks.
Wi-Fi Access Point: Wireless calibration via mobile/tablet/laptop.
Multi-Load Monitoring: High-precision support for multi-hook cranes.

calibrationSetup.title: Seamless Setup & Smart Control
calibrationSetup.description: The SLI system features a built-in Wi-Fi Access Point, enabling wireless calibration. Includes specialized Wind Speed limit settings and Angle Reset for outdoor stability.
steps: Tilt Angle Setup: Instant 0° calibration for ground stability.
Wind Speed Config: Input safe limits for automatic high-wind shutdown.
Multi-Load Calibration: Up to 8 points for diverse lifting ranges.
Wireless Sync: Full control via mobile-friendly web interface.

safetyParameters.title: Overload Protection (OVLD)

safetyParameters.title: Wind Speed Monitoring

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Tilt Protection (ATP)

safetyParameters.title: Error Indication (ERR)

safe-load-indicator-telescopic-crane.overview: Automated capacity monitoring for telescopic cranes. Dynamically tracks boom length and angle to calculate safe lifting limits across all extension stages.

safe-load-indicator-pick-and-carry-crane.name: Safe Load Indicator – Pick & Carry Crane
safe-load-indicator-pick-and-carry-crane.tagline: Advanced Hydraulic Protection and Display-Based Calibration System
safe-load-indicator-pick-and-carry-crane.overview: The Hejaaz Technologies Pick & Carry Crane SLI (Model SLI-PNC/V1.1) is a comprehensive safety system designed specifically for mobile Pick & Carry crane operations. Featuring real-time load monitoring, Anti-Two-Block protection, and automatic hydraulic cut-off, this system prevents overloading, boom collisions, and unsafe lifting conditions. The integrated 20×4 LCD display enables on-site calibration and configuration without external tools, making it ideal for remote and harsh industrial environments.

systemLayout.title: Pick & Carry SLI System Configuration
items: 20×4 LCD Display Unit with Programming Interface
Pressure Sensors (2-core wire) - Red: +VE, Black: -VE Signal
Load Cell (4-core wire) - Red: +VE, Black: -VE, White: -VE Signal, Green: +VE Signal
Cable Tension Drum (5-core wire) - Angle & Length Sensors
Standard Limit Switch for Safety Monitoring
Alarm Unit with Buzzer and LED Indicators

features.title: Display-Based Control & Calibration
features.description: Complete on-board calibration through 20×4 LCD display with step-by-step guided menus. Configure load calibration (No-Load & Full-Load), Rated Capacity Limiter (RCL) parameters, boom angle/radius setup, with tamper-resistant password-protected access.

features.title: Real-Time Load Monitoring
features.description: Hydraulic pressure-based sensing combined with load cell measurements provides ±2.5% accuracy. Visual LED indicators show load status at 0%, 85% (warning), and 100% (maximum) of Safe Working Load.

features.title: Wire Connection System
features.description: Standardized color-coded wiring: Harness Cable (5-core) for main supply, buzzer, hydraulic cut-off. Load Cell (4-core) for precise sensing. Pressure Sensors (2-core) for hydraulic monitoring. Cable Drum (5-core) for angle, length, and A2B signals.

features.title: Seamless Setup Process
features.description: All crane parameters configured locally through display keypad. Calibration toggling for load, boom length, and boom angle. Safety limits locked after setup. Reliable site-ready operation even in restricted environments.

safetyParameters.title: Safe Working Load (SWL) Cut-Off
safetyParameters.description: Prevents lifting beyond rated crane capacity. Continuously monitors actual load vs rated SWL, triggers 'OVLD' warning on display, activates buzzer alert at overload condition, and provides automatic hydraulic cut-off to prevent toppling, tyre overload, and structural failure.

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Two-Block (A2B) Indication
safetyParameters.description: Prevents hook block collision with boom head during lifting operations. Detects minimum safe distance between hook block and boom tip, displays A2B warning on SLI display, activates audible alarm, and automatically stops hoist-up motion to prevent wire rope damage and boom structural failure.

safetyParameters.title: Hydraulic Cut-Off Protection
safetyParameters.description: Stops unsafe crane movement during critical fault or overload conditions. Automatically cuts off hydraulic functions when SWL is exceeded, A2B condition is active, or unsafe lifting detected. Prevents further hoisting, boom extension, and load instability for fail-safe operation.

safetyParameters.title: Intelligent Display Interface
safetyParameters.description: 20×4 LCD screen displays real-time crane operating data including load percentage, system status, calibration menus, warnings, and fault messages. Features PROG button for calibration access, UP/DOWN arrows for navigation, ENT button for confirmation, and RED bypass button for authorized service use only.

specs.value: Overload alarm, SWL status, A2B warning, buzzer indicator
